items.q: Can we bring our data from our current CRM?
items.a: Yes. Import leads, accounts, contacts, deals and products from CSV files. A dry run comes first, and every row that fails is listed with its reason.
Omani rials are the base, to three decimals. Any quote, order or invoice can also be in UAE dirhams or Indian rupees, at the rate your admin set for that day.
Per line, from the product’s VAT category: standard 5%, zero-rated or exempt. Each line is rounded half-up to the currency’s decimals, and the document shows a summary by category.
Numbers come from one company-wide sequence with no gaps and are never reused. An issued invoice is locked; cancelling it keeps its number.
Its owner and the people they report to. Accounts and contacts are shared with the whole company, so nobody keys in the same customer twice.

items.q: Do we need the WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: No. Sending opens WhatsApp on your phone or computer with the message ready and a private link to the PDF. The link opens only that file, expires after 7 days and can be revoked.

items.q: Does it work on a phone?
items.a: Every screen works on a phone, from converting a lead to sending a quote on WhatsApp.
The app is in English today. It is built to switch to Arabic and right-to-left layouts without a redesign.
Your admin invites each person by email and gives them a role: admin, manager or rep. There is no public sign-up yet; write to us and we will set up your team.
